# Auto Post Badge PRO

![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-0BSD-blue.svg) [![Latest Stable Version](https://img.shields.io/packagist/v/justoverclock/auto-post-badge-pro.svg)](https://packagist.org/packages/justoverclock/auto-post-badge-pro) [![Total Downloads](https://img.shields.io/packagist/dt/justoverclock/auto-post-badge-pro.svg)](https://packagist.org/packages/justoverclock/auto-post-badge-pro)

A [Flarum](http://flarum.org) extension. Build your own automated reputation systems, setup levels, icons, text and number of post directly from extension settings.

## New Functions

The badge now shows a coloured progress bar that indicates when an user is near to the next level

![Immagine 2021-11-26 140949](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/79002016/143586823-11f31b45-7202-437a-85e5-b7cd16f22176.png)


![visual](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/79002016/143414489-0c4f54be-e998-4b3b-941d-cdef88e0c5ac.png)


## Installation

Install with composer:

```sh
composer require justoverclock/auto-post-badge-pro:"*"
```

## Updating

```sh
composer update justoverclock/auto-post-badge-pro:"*"
php flarum cache:clear
```
